scenarios.pass_condition: The target synthetic consumer can be bound with a stable tenant-scoped identity through an official capability.
The application can send the allowed generic message and obtain a documented outcome.
Callbacks are authenticated, replay-protected, tenant-scoped, and correlated.
A synthetic user can opt out and all queued messages are suppressed.
Employee departure, admin rotation, and tenant change invalidate stale access without cross-user delivery.
The generic message opens a Universal Link that requires login and resource authorization.
Ambiguous, stale, and mismatched bindings fail closed with no delivery.
Consent and binding state are rechecked immediately before provider submission.
